kirby.title: Kirby’s Dream Land · Castle Lololo
kirby.label: 별의 커비 · 캐슬 로로로
kirby.evidence: At 69.7–75.5, a black Shotzo fixed to the wall repeatedly fires black projectiles while Kirby moves up. Later hazards at 143.8–163.5 are separately viewed as a platform sequence. The 6-step cycle is shown by our authored study.

pyra.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate · Pyra, Classic Mode
pyra.label: 슈퍼 스매시브라더스 얼티밋 · 호무라
pyra.evidence: Red Pyra at local 36–39 leaves an orange sword trail during a visible attack. The video does not identify that attack as Blazing End.

pyraLater.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate · Pyra, Cloud Sea of Alrest
pyraLater.label: 슈퍼 스매시브라더스 얼티밋 · 호무라
pyraLater.evidence: Different match. Red Pyra’s bright sword arcs at 23, 48–49 and 94–97 are visibly distinct from Mythra’s green attacks. The pivot comparison illustrates the move design; no production build or measured retail pivot is claimed.
